# Dawkins Construction LLC

Dawkins Construction LLC is an owner-led general contractor and custom carpentry company based in Foster, Rhode Island. The company has served Rhode Island homeowners since 2004 and is also known as Dawkins Construction and Dawkins Brothers Construction.

## Services

- Custom carpentry and finish work
- Home additions and renovations
- Kitchen and bathroom remodeling
- Deck construction
- Barn construction
- Outdoor structures

## Service area

Foster, Rhode Island, and neighboring Rhode Island communities.

- Website: https://dawkinsbros.com/
- Phone: +1-401-855-3705
- Project inquiries: https://dawkinsbros.com/#contact
- Client and trade portals: https://dawkinsbros.com/#project-desk

## Business approach

Dawkins Construction emphasizes careful planning, clear communication, considerate work, sound materials, and respect for each client's home.
